en.text: Job again took up his parable, and said,

zhSimplified.text: 约伯接着说：

zhTraditional.text: 約伯接着說：

en.text: “As God lives, who has taken away my right, the Almighty, who has made my soul bitter

zhSimplified.text: 神夺去我的理，全能者使我心中愁苦。 我指着永生的 神起誓：

zhTraditional.text: 上帝奪去我的理，全能者使我心中愁苦。 我指着永生的上帝起誓：

en.text: (for the length of my life is still in me, and the spirit of God is in my nostrils);

zhSimplified.text: 我的生命尚在我里面； 神所赐呼吸之气仍在我的鼻孔内。

zhTraditional.text: 我的生命尚在我裏面； 上帝所賜呼吸之氣仍在我的鼻孔內。

en.text: surely my lips will not speak unrighteousness, neither will my tongue utter deceit.

zhSimplified.text: 我的嘴决不说非义之言； 我的舌也不说诡诈之语。

zhTraditional.text: 我的嘴決不說非義之言； 我的舌也不說詭詐之語。

en.text: Far be it from me that I should justify you. Until I die I will not put away my integrity from me.

zhSimplified.text: 我断不以你们为是； 我至死必不以自己为不正！

zhTraditional.text: 我斷不以你們為是； 我至死必不以自己為不正！

en.text: I hold fast to my righteousness, and will not let it go. My heart will not reproach me so long as I live.

zhSimplified.text: 我持定我的义，必不放松； 在世的日子，我心必不责备我。

zhTraditional.text: 我持定我的義，必不放鬆； 在世的日子，我心必不責備我。

en.text: “Let my enemy be as the wicked. Let him who rises up against me be as the unrighteous.

zhSimplified.text: 愿我的仇敌如恶人一样； 愿那起来攻击我的，如不义之人一般。

zhTraditional.text: 願我的仇敵如惡人一樣； 願那起來攻擊我的，如不義之人一般。

en.text: For what is the hope of the godless, when he is cut off, when God takes away his life?

zhSimplified.text: 不敬虔的人虽然得利， 神夺取其命的时候还有什么指望呢？

zhTraditional.text: 不敬虔的人雖然得利， 上帝奪取其命的時候還有甚麼指望呢？

en.text: Will God hear his cry when trouble comes on him?

zhSimplified.text: 患难临到他， 神岂能听他的呼求？

zhTraditional.text: 患難臨到他， 上帝豈能聽他的呼求？

en.text: Will he delight himself in the Almighty, and call on God at all times?

zhSimplified.text: 他岂以全能者为乐， 随时求告 神呢？

zhTraditional.text: 他豈以全能者為樂， 隨時求告上帝呢？

en.text: I will teach you about the hand of God. I will not conceal that which is with the Almighty.

zhSimplified.text: 神的作为，我要指教你们； 全能者所行的，我也不隐瞒。

zhTraditional.text: 上帝的作為，我要指教你們； 全能者所行的，我也不隱瞞。

en.text: Behold, all of you have seen it yourselves; why then have you become altogether vain?

zhSimplified.text: 你们自己也都见过， 为何全然变为虚妄呢？

zhTraditional.text: 你們自己也都見過， 為何全然變為虛妄呢？

en.text: “This is the portion of a wicked man with God, the heritage of oppressors, which they receive from the Almighty.

zhSimplified.text: 神为恶人所定的分， 强暴人从全能者所得的报乃是这样：

zhTraditional.text: 上帝為惡人所定的分， 強暴人從全能者所得的報乃是這樣：

en.text: If his children are multiplied, it is for the sword. His offspring will not be satisfied with bread.

zhSimplified.text: 倘或他的儿女增多，还是被刀所杀； 他的子孙必不得饱食。

zhTraditional.text: 倘或他的兒女增多，還是被刀所殺； 他的子孫必不得飽食。

en.text: Those who remain of him will be buried in death. His widows will make no lamentation.

zhSimplified.text: 他所遗留的人必死而埋葬； 他的寡妇也不哀哭。

zhTraditional.text: 他所遺留的人必死而埋葬； 他的寡婦也不哀哭。

en.text: Though he heap up silver as the dust, and prepare clothing as the clay;

zhSimplified.text: 他虽积蓄银子如尘沙， 预备衣服如泥土；

zhTraditional.text: 他雖積蓄銀子如塵沙， 預備衣服如泥土；

en.text: he may prepare it, but the just will put it on, and the innocent will divide the silver.

zhSimplified.text: 他只管预备，义人却要穿上； 他的银子，无辜的人要分取。

zhTraditional.text: 他只管預備，義人卻要穿上； 他的銀子，無辜的人要分取。

en.text: He builds his house as the moth, as a booth which the watchman makes.

zhSimplified.text: 他建造房屋如虫做窝， 又如守望者所搭的棚。

zhTraditional.text: 他建造房屋如蟲做窩， 又如守望者所搭的棚。

en.text: He lies down rich, but he will not do so again. He opens his eyes, and he is not.

zhSimplified.text: 他虽富足躺卧，却不得收殓， 转眼之间就不在了。

zhTraditional.text: 他雖富足躺臥，卻不得收殮， 轉眼之間就不在了。

en.text: Terrors overtake him like waters. A storm steals him away in the night.

zhSimplified.text: 惊恐如波涛将他追上； 暴风在夜间将他刮去。

zhTraditional.text: 驚恐如波濤將他追上； 暴風在夜間將他颳去。

en.text: The east wind carries him away, and he departs. It sweeps him out of his place.

zhSimplified.text: 东风把他飘去， 又刮他离开本处。

zhTraditional.text: 東風把他飄去， 又颳他離開本處。

en.text: For it hurls at him, and does not spare, as he flees away from his hand.

zhSimplified.text: 神要向他射箭，并不留情； 他恨不得逃脱 神的手。

zhTraditional.text: 上帝要向他射箭，並不留情； 他恨不得逃脫上帝的手。

en.text: Men will clap their hands at him, and will hiss him out of his place.

zhSimplified.text: 人要向他拍掌， 并要发叱声，使他离开本处。

zhTraditional.text: 人要向他拍掌， 並要發叱聲，使他離開本處。
